text:
Andrew: Heads up — canary shows a perf regression right after the kernel-selector merge (commit abcdef1). p99 latency for long-context generation is ~2.5x higher on mixed-batch tests :frowning:
Liz: I saw CI perf alerts this morning, looks like perf-canary-7 failed, linking artifacts
ci-bot: Perf CI: job perf-canary-7 failed — https://ci.redwood/artefacts/perf-canary-7 — regression detected between 9f8e7d6 -> abcdef1
Priya: I'll run a bisect now and post the log
Priya: bisect snippet:
```
git bisect start
# bad: abcdef1
# good: 9f8e7d6
git bisect run ./scripts/run_perf_canary.sh
# result: first bad commit abcdef1
```
Priya: Found the likely culprit. abcdef1 changed the kernel selection threshold to prefer tensor-core kernels for seqlen > 512. Under mixed batch mixes (small + one large), we see p99 spikes — looks like an interaction with KV cache evictions
Vinay: that makes sense, the new selector increases kernel switches which thrashes the KV cache and inflates latency for some request shapes
Tom: Can we revert that selector tweak on release branch until we fix the heuristics? Reverting should be lower risk than a risky revert in main
Andrew: I agree. Proposal: prepare a hotfix on release-1.9 that reverts abcdef1, run perf CI, then cherry-pick a rollback into main (so main and release aligned)
Liz: I'll draft the hotfix PRs and mark them for expedited review
Liz: Draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4321 (revert abcdef1 + small test) — WIP
Priya: Running local perf harness with the revert applied to canary — initial numbers look promising: baseline p99 ~480ms -> regressed ~1200ms -> after revert ~500ms (within noise)
Andrew: Nice. Steps I want: 1) get PR approval 2) run perf CI + 2 canary deploys 3) verify traces & KV metrics 4) promote
Vinay: I will also add logging to the selector to record chosen kernel + sequence length on canary so we can replay the exact mix
Liz: CI perf job queued for the hotfix PR. Link: https://ci.redwood/jobs/9876
ci-bot: Deploy pipeline started for canary-hotfix-1961234567 — https://deploys.redwood/pipelines/1961234567
Liz: First canary run completed — traces show fewer kernel switches and no KV evictions spike :+1:
Priya: Attaching flamegraph and p99 series: https://perf.redwood/plots/1961234567-flame.svg
Tom: If canary stays stable for the next run, merge to release-1.9 and backport to main. I'll coordinate the release cut and notify SRE for post-merge monitor windows
Liz: Merged hotfix to release-1.9 and opened backport PR to main (PR 4322). CI green on both. :tada:
Vinay: Follow-up issue created to rework kernel scoring and add a mixed-batch KV-cache regression test: https://github.com/redwood/inference/issues/789 — assigned to me
Andrew: Thanks all — please monitor telemetry for 24h, then we'll schedule the longer R&D fix into the 1-week sprint. Closing thread once the 24h looks clean :pray:
